title: Big Eye Louis Nelson, Ernest Rogers and Walter Decou
summary: Russell recalls hearing Nelson in 1942; talk of drummer Ernest Rogers and pianist Walter Decou.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: With the big guy Louie Nelson, he played with him for a while. But I never really knew him. My wife died, she was playing with big guy Louie.

Well she was playing down there. She played there a while down there, yeah. But that's about when I first heard him, 1942, the year she died. Yeah. Big guy Louie you mean? Yeah. First time I heard big guy.
Yeah. That's the first time I heard big guy.
Yeah. Ernest Rogers was playing drums down there.
Yeah, Ernest Rogers was playing then. Yeah, Ernest Rogers.
Yeah, Ernest Rogers. Yeah. I forget who was on piano. Maybe Benny Turner or somebody.
Oh no, I know Walter Deku.
Walter Deku, yeah. Yeah, I guess he was with him. I played Walt before he got nuts right.
Yeah, I remember he had that trouble. Mm-hm. He's still around town but I haven't seen him before. Was Walter Deco? Walter Deco, yeah. I played Walter before he got nuts, I had to stop playing.
Yeah, I remember he had that trouble.
He's still around town, but I haven't seen him before.
Yeah, he lived down Gentilly. Somebody's been waiting on the river. Good piano player was too. Yeah, good piano player.
You know, Buck Johnson had him to make some records with him when he first met in 1942. Yeah, Buck had stopped and remember when he got me come back here?
